# Results — SmartphoneAddiction (Kaggle PS S6E8)

Metric: **ROC AUC** (higher is better), using continuous positive-class probabilities.
Full runs use five-fold stratified CV; finalists average seeds 42, 123, and 2026. Full
per-run log: `SmartphoneAddiction/experiments/README.md`.

**Submitted (2):** LightGBM behavior three-seed bag -> sub 55698328, public 0.96373;
XGBoost missingness three-seed bag -> sub 55714637, public 0.96479. The public gain
(+0.00106) matches the aligned OOF gain (+0.001057), supporting the local selection.

**Null/rejected results:** compact features, original-data augmentation at weights 1
and 5, the source-rule feature, and LightGBM/XGBoost blending. The best blend found
before repeating XGBoost was only 0.963515 OOF; once XGBoost was averaged across three
seeds, adding LightGBM reduced AUC. CatBoost, tuning, and TabM remain unexecuted rather
than being represented by invented comparisons.
